explication: Modlishka is a configurable, plugin-extensible HTTP(S) reverse proxy for authorized security testing and related proxy use cases. Its main workflow loads configuration and plugins, starts HTTP/TLS listeners, routes browser traffic to target domains, and rewrites responses for the proxy domain. The documented credential collection/control panel, dynamic client-domain hooking, and automatic certificate generation are represented as capability branches; some of their wiring is not visible in the sampled excerpts, so those links are marked unverified.
